    function getCookieValue(name) { 
        const cookie = document.cookie 
            .split('; ') 
            .find((entry) => entry.startsWith(`${name}=`)); 
        const cookieValue = cookie ? cookie.split('=').slice(1).join('=') : ''; 
        return decodeURIComponent(cookieValue); 
    } 
 
    function shouldUseCookieBannerV2() { 
        const configElement = document.getElementById('one-trust-config'); 
 
        if (!configElement) { 
            return false; 
        } 
 
        const configuredRegions  = JSON.parse(configElement.dataset.regions || '[]'); 
        const cookieBannerV2Enabled = configElement.dataset.cookieBannerV2Enabled === 'true'; 
        const countryRegionCode = getCookieValue('country_region_code').toUpperCase(); 
        const shouldShowV2 = configuredRegions.some((region) => 
            region.toUpperCase() === countryRegionCode 
        ); 
 
        return cookieBannerV2Enabled || shouldShowV2; 
    } 
 
    function initCookieBannerV2() { 
        if (window._tcccOtBannerDismissed) return; 
 
        const acceptRecommendedBtn = document.querySelector("#accept-recommended-btn-handler");

        n.classList.add("ot-modal-open"); 
 
        if (btnContainer && acceptRecommendedBtn) { 
            btnContainer.insertAdjacentElement("afterbegin", acceptRecommendedBtn); 
        }

            if (event.target.closest("#onetrust-accept-btn-handler, #onetrust-reject-all-handler")) { 
                window._tcccOtBannerDismissed = true; 
                n.classList.remove("ot-modal-open"); 
                document.removeEventListener("click", removeBannerLock, true); 
            } 
        }, true); 
    } 
 
    var useCookieBannerV2 = shouldUseCookieBannerV2(); 
 
    document.body.classList.toggle("cookie-banner-v2", useCookieBannerV2);

            initCookieBannerV2(); 
        } 
    } else {
